scripts.predev:all: npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:api
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis minio
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e server/.env -- npx --prefix server prisma migrate dev --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e server/.env -- npx --prefix server prisma migrate deploy --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e server/.env -- npm run prisma:seed --prefix server
